text:
Marisa C: Heads up on GreenHarbor renewal — legal is asking for a 9‑month term instead of 12, procurement requires a wet-signed PO + vendor code, and their CFO (chris@greenharbor.com) is OOO until Fri. Need to confirm alternate signer or accept scanned PO. :wave:
contract-bot: Draft amendment created: GH-2026-AMEND v1 — https://contracts.internal/GH-2026-AMEND (locked for legal review)
Alex R: Quick q — are we agreeing to a price change for 9mo? sales originally quoted 18% off for 12mo, rep wrote 10% for 9mo.
Marisa C: Correct, rep proposed 10% on the shorter term. Finance flagged that net terms and PO timing matter for provisioning.
Sam F: Finance note: we need vendor code, Tax ID (W-9), and PO number before we can finalize invoice. If they want Net30 instead of upfront, AR needs to approve. Also confirm if KMS onboarding is billed separately (SOW).
Priya M: CSM checked in with the customer — onboarding is still in pilot. They want SSO/KMS validated before committing to full Dedicated capacity. That may delay signature, they might want to hold until SSO test passes.
Jen (Legal): Legal: 9mo term is acceptable but we need to keep our standard indemnity and data clauses. If a non-CFO signs, we need an explicit delegated authority email or a delegation attachment.
Marisa C: @Priya can you confirm whether they have a delegated signer? If not, ask if they will sign by proxy (email from authority) or provide a wet-signed PO.
Priya M: Just heard back — VP of Ops (laura@greenharbor.com) can sign, procurement still insists on original wet-signed PO and a current W-9. ETA from client: Tue morning for scanned PO + W-9, and courier for originals mid-week.
Alex R: If they send a scanned wet PO + W-9 tomorrow, can we provision on a provisional basis? Also they might true-up +20 seats at renewal — need an addendum.
Sam F: We can provision with a billing hold if we have a PO number on file and AR manager OKs it. For Dedicated capacity we need PO before enabling hardware; provisional provisioning is possible for onboarding tasks only.
Marisa C: Proposed action items:
```
- Priya: collect scanned wet PO, courier ETA, and W-9 (due Tue)
- Priya: obtain delegated authority email and confirm signer's name
- Alex: prepare revised quote (9mo, 10% discount) + seat addendum for +20 seats
- Jen: approve clause retention and prepare delegation wording
- Sam: pre-check AR for provisional billing path
```
If any piece slips past Fri we'll offer a 7‑day extension so they don't lose current pricing.
Priya M: Client confirmed they'll email a scanned wet PO and W-9 tomorrow morning and are fine with starting onboarding activities before final signature if we accept a provisional PO clause.
Jen (Legal): We can allow onboarding to start but Legal will require this clause added: "Company may commence onboarding prior to execution of an amendment; such work is at Customer's risk and does not constitute acceptance of terms unless the amendment is executed." Send me the exact placement and I'll slot it in.
Marisa C: Thanks — I'll update the draft, add the clause from Jen, and ping AR on the billing hold. I'll also set a reminder for Friday to follow up. :spiral_calendar:
Alex R: I'll attach the seat addendum and updated pricing to the draft and share link once ready.
Sam F: Noted. I'll flag AR to expect a potential provisional PO and confirm whether we can flip any provisioning flags on our side once a scanned PO + W-9 are in.
Marisa C: Great team — I'll repost the contract link once changes are in. Will also capture any handoff notes for Renewals playbook if this provisional flow becomes common.
